title: Upanga Dental Clinic — Booking Website
description: A fast 5-page website for a Dar es Salaam dental clinic with WhatsApp booking, Swahili and English content, and local SEO. Enquiries doubled within two months of launch.

sw.title: Kliniki ya Meno ya Upanga — Tovuti ya Miadi
sw.description: Tovuti ya kurasa 5 ya haraka kwa kliniki ya meno ya Dar es Salaam yenye booking ya WhatsApp, maudhui ya Kiswahili na Kiingereza, na SEO ya eneo. Maombi yaliongezeka mara mbili ndani ya miezi miwili baada ya uzinduzi.

title: Dar Fashion Retail — M-Pesa Online Store
description: An online store for a Dar es Salaam fashion retailer with product listings, inventory tracking, shopping cart and M-Pesa checkout. Order fulfilment time dropped from days to hours.

sw.title: Duka la Mitindo la Dar — Duka la M-Pesa
sw.description: Duka la mtandaoni la muuzaji wa mitindo la Dar es Salaam lenye orodha za bidhaa, ufuatiliaji wa stoo, kikapu na malipo ya M-Pesa. Muda wa utoaji wa maagizo ulipungua kutoka siku hadi masaa.

title: Distributor Inventory Dashboard
description: A custom web application with secure login, an inventory dashboard and an admin panel for managing stock, users and orders. Built with React and a hosted database for a Tanzanian distributor.

sw.title: Dashibodi ya Stoo ya Msambazaji
sw.description: Programu maalum ya mtandao yenye ingizo salama, dashibodi ya stoo na paneli ya usimamizi ya kusimamia stoo, watumiaji na maagizo. Imejengwa na React na hifadhidata inayopangishwa kwa msambazaji wa Tanzania.
